propositions: Close transition currently dispatches to LLM verifier even when ticket's Acceptance Criteria block contains unchecked '- [ ]' checkboxes, a deterministic fail condition that should short-circuit before LLM.
A deterministic precheck must be added to the close path to reject closes with unchecked AC items before verifier dispatch, with teaching message guidance.
Checkboxes preceded by the case-insensitive '[operator-attested]' tag must be exempted from the unchecked-box rejection, reusing the shared regex matcher from det_operator_attested to prevent drift.
Non-completion close classes (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated via replacement-link) must bypass the precheck unchanged.
Prose-only AC (lacking checkbox syntax) must pass the precheck without rejection.
